politicaPrivacidad.version: Version {{version}} — draft for the master's thesis, not written by legal counsel.
politicaPrivacidad.queDatosTexto: Your email, the name you give us when registering, and the entries you record in the categories you turn on (date of birth, gender, occupation and hobbies if you provide them, time zone, and your per-category check-ins). If you add trips on the Adventure page, we store the country, the year and, if you give it, the month. The map is part of the app: it doesn't request anything from other servers.
politicaPrivacidad.datosSensiblesTexto: Some categories (sex, spirituality) count as special category data under GDPR (art. 9). They're only turned on and recorded with your explicit consent, which you can withdraw at any time by turning the category off.
politicaPrivacidad.paraQueTexto: Only to give you your own tracking dashboard and personalized suggestions inside the app. It is never shared with third parties or used for advertising.
politicaPrivacidad.tusDerechosTexto: You can access, correct, or delete your data at any time from your profile. Turning a category off does not delete its history — use data export/deletion if you want to erase everything.
politicaPrivacidad.contactoTexto: This is an academic project (master's thesis) — for any question about your data, contact the project's developer directly.
politicaPrivacidad.iaTexto: It's optional and off by default. If you turn it on in Privacy & data, when you open an idea for a non-sensitive category, the following is sent to Anthropic, acting as data processor: the category, your latest score and whether it's going up or down, the options you ticked in "What helps you?", the occupation and hobbies in your profile if you set them (always options from a list, never your own text) and the app's ideas for that category. For these ideas, your name, your email, your private experiences, sensitive categories and the Couple category are never sent. The resulting idea is saved in your account so it isn't requested again. You can turn it off at any time and personalised ideas are deleted.
politicaPrivacidad.iaSugerenciasTexto: This is also optional, separate from the above and off by default. If you turn it on in Privacy and data, each experience in your diary shows “Suggest options with AI”: pressing it sends to Anthropic, as data processor, only the experience you ask to analyse, together with that category's possible options, so it can suggest which ones to mark in “What helps you?” or “What makes it hard?”. You accept or dismiss each suggestion; the AI writes nothing about you and doesn't assess how you are. Before sending it we remove emails, phone numbers, links and long numbers; names can't be removed reliably, so we ask you not to write other people's names if you don't want them sent. Your name, your email, your scores and the experiences you don't ask to analyse are never sent, and sensitive categories and the Couple category are never sent. You can turn it off whenever you like; only the options you accept remain from the AI.
politicaPrivacidad.compartidasTexto: If your latest score in a category is 8 or more, you can anonymously share an experience from your diary to help other people. Only the one you choose is shared, after you see how it will look. Other people using the app only read the text, among the ideas for that category and in your same language: never your name, your email, the date or your score. Before publishing it we check that it has no contact details, health or money advice, or insults. Experiences from sensitive categories or Relationship are never shared. Bear in mind that if you tell very personal details, someone who knows you might recognise you. You can stop sharing it whenever you like, in your diary or in Privacy and data; if someone reports it, it's hidden. It's deleted when you delete the experience or your account.
politicaPrivacidad.iaLimiteTexto: To prevent abuse, we count how many times a day you use these AI features (only the number, not what you ask or what is answered), and there is a daily maximum per person. If you go over it, you'll see the app's original ideas until the next day. That counter is deleted with your account.

ocio.texto: All your categories are green. There's nothing you need to improve: these ideas are for enjoying it.

ideas.1: Give yourself some time just for you, with no goal and no to-do list.
ideas.2: Keep an afternoon for something you enjoy just because: a film, a walk, a book.
ideas.3: Treat yourself to something small: a massage, a long bath or your favourite meal.
ideas.4: Plan a getaway or a few days of rest, even close to home.
ideas.5: Spend some good time with someone you love, for no other reason than enjoying it.
ideas.6: Take a break from this app too: come back in a few weeks, whenever you feel like it.
ideas.7: Write down three things that are going well, to have them at hand another day.
ideas.8: Celebrate what you have built: what you have now is also something you have looked after.

recomendaciones.aviso: These ideas are general wellbeing suggestions and do not replace professional medical, financial or psychological advice.

economia.1: If you feel like it, note down where your money goes for a week, without judging yourself: just looking already helps.
economia.2: Try setting aside a small amount as soon as you're paid, even a symbolic one. The habit is what matters.
economia.3: Pick a small, recurring expense that doesn't give you much and try a week without it, just to see how it feels.
economia.4: Write down a concrete, near savings goal, like a small treat, and how much is left to reach it.
economia.5: If talking about money helps you, share what worries you with someone you trust; putting it into words already clears things up.

vidaSocial.1: Write today to someone you haven't spoken to in a while: a short message is enough to reconnect.
vidaSocial.2: Suggest a simple plan this week, like a coffee or a walk with someone you feel good around.
vidaSocial.3: Bring back something you used to enjoy doing with other people, even just once this month.
vidaSocial.4: Calmly reply to that message you've been putting off; sometimes the first step is already taken.
vidaSocial.5: If you feel like it, look for a small, relaxed group activity around something you enjoy.

pareja.1: Set aside a screen-free moment this week to be together, even if it's only twenty minutes.
pareja.2: Tell your partner something you've appreciated about them lately; small details add up.
pareja.3: Ask your partner how they really are and listen without hurrying or looking for solutions.
pareja.4: Try something new together this week, even something small: a recipe, a different walk, a game.
pareja.5: Keep some time for yourself too: looking after your own space often does the relationship good.

sexo.1: Talking calmly about what you like or feel uncomfortable with often helps; pick a moment with no rush and no pressure.
sexo.2: Take some time to look after yourself and find out what feels good, with no goals or expectations.
sexo.3: Notice which moments of the day leave you calmer and with more energy; wellbeing often starts there.
sexo.4: If you feel like it, read up from reliable sources on something you're curious about, at your own pace.
sexo.5: Remember there's no right way to live it: what matters is feeling good and respected.

deporte.1: Go for a twenty-minute walk today: starting small beats not starting.
deporte.2: Pick an activity you enjoy and put it in your calendar twice this week.
deporte.3: Put on a song you like and move while it plays; it counts as a good start.
deporte.4: Find a way of moving that fits into your day, like walking somewhere you usually drive to.
deporte.5: If you like being outdoors, plan an easy walk outside this weekend.

aventura.1: Change one small routine this week: a different route, a new dish, a place you don't know.
aventura.2: Write down a plan you're excited about, even a small one, and give it a date.
aventura.3: Learn something small you've always been curious about, from a video or a book, with no pressure.
aventura.4: Visit a corner of your own town you don't know, as if you were travelling.
aventura.5: Set yourself a small, reachable challenge for this month and celebrate when you get there.

espiritualidad.1: Give yourself five minutes of silence a day, phone away, to be with yourself.
espiritualidad.2: Write down what gives you meaning lately and what you'd like to nurture more.
espiritualidad.3: Before going to sleep, think of one thing from the day you feel grateful for.
espiritualidad.4: Read a few pages of something that inspires or calms you, even for a short while.
espiritualidad.5: Spend some time in a place that feels peaceful to you, like a park or a quiet spot.

familia.1: Call someone in your family this week just to ask how they are.
familia.2: Suggest a meal or some time together: sometimes a small initiative is enough.
familia.3: Bring back a small family tradition you enjoy, or come up with a new one.
familia.4: Offer to help someone in your family with something specific; simple gestures bring you closer.
familia.5: Share something good that happened to you this week with someone in your family.

inversiones.1: Spend half an hour reviewing where your money is and what each part is for.
inversiones.2: Read up from reliable sources on one basic idea, like diversification, before deciding anything.
inversiones.3: Write down what you want your money for in the long run; a clear goal helps you decide calmly.
inversiones.4: Before any important decision, give yourself a few days to think it over and don't let urgency carry you away.
inversiones.5: If you have doubts, consider talking to an independent professional before deciding anything.

general.1: Pick one small action related to {{categoria}} that you can do this week and write it down.
general.2: Think about what weighs on you most in {{categoria}} and which small change would ease it.
general.3: Ask yourself what would help most right now in {{categoria}} and take a first step, however small.

salud.1: This week, go to bed half an hour earlier one night and notice how you wake up.
salud.2: Step outside for ten minutes of daylight, unhurried and without your phone.
salud.3: Keep a bottle of water in sight in the place where you spend most of your time.
salud.4: For every hour you spend sitting, stand up and stretch for a minute.
salud.5: For three days, write down in a single word how you feel when you wake up.

tecnologia.1: Pick a screen-free moment each day this week and see what you do with that time.
tecnologia.2: Turn off notifications for an app that often interrupts you and see whether you miss it.
tecnologia.3: Learn one new thing with a tool you already use: a shortcut or a feature you didn't know.
tecnologia.4: Leave your phone outside the bedroom for one night and see how you wake up.
tecnologia.5: Spend half an hour tidying your photos or files: less noise, and easier to find what matters.

calendario.categoriasAyuda: If you choose any, on the day of the event Home will invite you to review your score in it.
calendario.avisoRevision: On the day of the event, Home will invite you to review your score in what you chose, whether it went well or not. The app never changes it for you.

paginasCategoria.intro: Each category will have its own page with what you have lived in it: memories and achievements to remember and to keep you going. We are starting with Adventure.
paginasCategoria.sinPagina: This category doesn't have a page yet.
paginasCategoria.sinExperiencias: You haven't noted any experiences in this category yet. You can do it from the interview.
paginasCategoria.avisoMarcas: The header image is AI-generated and used for illustrative purposes only in a non-profit academic project. Any brands, logos or competition names that may appear belong to their owners, who are not affiliated with or endorse this app.

intro.aventura: What you've achieved: a summit, a long trek, that challenge that made you nervous. To remember it when things get hard.
intro.deporte: Your races, competitions and personal bests, from any year. To remember what you're capable of.

hitos.ninguno: You haven't added any milestones yet.
hitos.noCambianNota: Your milestones are yours alone: they don't change your score, aren't sent to the AI and aren't shared.

viajes.intro: The countries you have visited, or are planning to visit, from any year. A map of your memories and of what you still want to see.
viajes.mapaNoCarga: The map couldn't be loaded. Your trips are still below; try reloading the page.
viajes.comoUsarMapa: Visited countries are shown filled in. Hover to see when you went and click one to choose it below. Zoom with Ctrl + scroll (⌘ on Mac), by pinching or with + and −.
viajes.ninguno: You haven't added any trips yet.
viajes.error: We couldn't save that change. Please try again.
viajes.noCambianNota: Your trips are only yours: they don't change your score, they are not sent to the AI and they are not shared.
viajes.avisoRueda: Use Ctrl + scroll (⌘ + scroll on Mac) to zoom the map
viajes.avisoDosDedos: Use two fingers to move the map

avisos.evento: How did "{{titulo}}" go? If you like, review your score in {{categorias}}.
avisos.idea: You planned to try an idea for {{categoria}} on {{fecha}}.
avisos.revisar_one: {{categoria}} hasn't been reviewed for {{count}} week. Is it still the same?
avisos.revisar_other: {{categoria}} hasn't been reviewed for {{count}} weeks. Is it still the same?
avisos.perfil: Complete your profile: choose an avatar and, if you like, your occupation and hobbies, so ideas fit you better.

perfilIa.noDisponible: AI isn't available in this installation: the ideas are always the app's own.
perfilIa.activadas: AI ideas are on: the AI adapts the wording of the app's ideas with this data.
perfilIa.desactivadas: AI ideas are off: nothing is sent to the AI right now.
perfilIa.recibiria: If you turn them on, from your profile it would receive:
perfilIa.nadaDelPerfil: Nothing: you haven't set an occupation or hobbies.
perfilIa.ademas: And, for each non-sensitive category, your score, whether it's going up or down and what you ticked in "What helps you?".
perfilIa.nuncaLista: Your name, your email, your date of birth, your gender, your written experiences or anything from sensitive categories.
perfilIa.cambiar: Change it in Privacy and data
perfilIa.activar: Turn them on in Privacy and data

videos.intro: Video talks that might give you ideas or a push. Chosen by the app's author.
videos.aviso: Images and videos come from YouTube: when you play one, YouTube knows you visited (no tracking cookies until you press play).

comunidad.intro: What other people who are doing well in this area share anonymously.
comunidad.ninguna: Nobody has shared anything in this category yet. When things go well for you, you can share an experience from your diary in the interview.

sesion.caducadaTexto: For your security, your session closes after two days without using the app. Sign in again to carry on; if you were saving something, please do it again afterwards.
